hero.title: Disaster Preparedness and Response Hub
hero.subtitle: Prepare before. Respond safely. Recover together.

quickAccess.label: QUICK ACCESS
quickAccess.familyDesc: Family emergency plan, contacts and safety status.
quickAccess.healthDesc: Keep important health information accessible in an emergency.

phases.beforeIntro: Small preparations made before an emergency can make it easier to protect yourself and your family when conditions change quickly.
phases.duringIntro: Follow the safest action for the hazard. If there is an immediate threat to life, contact emergency services.
phases.afterIntro: Once the immediate danger has passed, focus on people first, then move carefully towards recovery.

gobag.title: Emergency Go-Bag
gobag.desc: Keep water, medication, first aid supplies, power bank, torch, whistle and important documents ready.

familyPlan.title: Family Emergency Plan
familyPlan.desc: Agree on meeting points, emergency contacts and what to do if family members become separated.

docs.title: Important Documents
docs.desc: Keep identification, medical information, insurance details and emergency contacts accessible.

power.title: Power & Communication
power.desc: Keep phones charged and have backup power available so you can receive emergency updates.

flood.title: Flash Flood
flood.desc: Move to higher ground. Avoid flooded roads, underpasses and underground areas. Never walk or drive through floodwater.

heat.title: Extreme Heat
heat.desc: Drink water regularly, reduce strenuous activity and seek a cool indoor location if you feel unwell.

haze.title: Haze / Poor Air Quality
haze.desc: Monitor air-quality conditions, reduce prolonged outdoor activity and use appropriate respiratory protection when necessary.

weather.title: Severe Weather
weather.desc: Stay indoors when conditions become dangerous and keep away from exposed areas, windows and unsecured objects.

injuries.title: Check for Injuries
injuries.desc: Check yourself and people around you. Call emergency services for serious injuries.

family.title: Account for Family
family.desc: Use your agreed meeting point and contact plan to confirm that family members are safe.

environment.title: Check Your Environment
environment.desc: Do not enter unsafe buildings or areas with standing water, electrical hazards or structural damage.

damage.title: Document Damage
damage.desc: When it is safe, record relevant damage and keep important information for follow-up and recovery.

resources.footer: This hub provides preparedness information and quick access to safety tools. Always follow official emergency instructions during an active incident.
